scientific_integrity: Complete finite simplicial collapse independently replayed from embedded code and certificate; exact integral homotopy conclusion uses the classification of closed connected surfaces.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the 30-vertex icosidodecahedral graph equipped with shortest-path distance and inclusive scale-one and scale-two Rips complexes; it is not a general statement about all polyhedra or larger radii. The finite collapse has a deterministic full-face certificate, not a separately certified formal proof. An unindexed equivalent result cannot be excluded.
title: A two-sphere at scale two for the icosidodecahedral graph
